data.message: I opt in to 18 tons this month, even if others choose 10; this is individual, not all-or-nothing. Each switch from 10 adds $8,000 now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). At k=25, 50 remain, with next stock 500 or 100—not risk-free or guaranteed best long-run. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Each fisher: state your exact intended catch and any conditions.
